answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and files a voyage log. A beacon draws a peer auditor to re-run that voyage; both logs are compared at a summit. The queue plants one fable claim: an auditor rubber-stamping the fable loses its bond. First audit 45, k-th 45+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,041,000 + 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-auditor ring fails when paired logs diverge over 3%. An honest agent pays 45 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
